semiconductor_relevance: Medium — AC&C Technology provides specialized cleaning solutions for semiconductor mold maintenance, which is relevant but not core to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: AC&C Technology Pte Ltd manufactures mold cleaning rubber sheets and solid-state cleaning solutions specifically designed for semiconductor encapsulation and precision rubber molding. Their products, including COW cleaning sheets and WOW conditioning sheets, enhance mold performance and longevity, thereby supporting production efficiency.

regional_presence.Singapore: AC&C Technology is based in Singapore, where it manufactures its mold cleaning solutions.
